pick.headline: Syrian forces oust General Aoun in Lebanon
pick.summary: On 13 October 1990 Syrian forces attacked the presidential palace at Ba'abda, and General Michel Aoun, who had rejected the Taif Agreement, took refuge in the French Embassy.
pick.significance: Syria's move, tolerated by Washington as Damascus joined the coalition against Iraq, ended the civil war and confirmed Syrian dominance in Lebanon.
